blogs.title: When Behçet’s Hits the Brain: Recognizing Acute Neuro‑Behçet’s at First Presentation
blogs.description: A deep dive into the clinical clues that should raise suspicion for neuro‑Behçet’s disease in patients who present simultaneously with mucocutaneous lesions and non‑specific CNS symptoms. We’ll discuss epidemiology, typical vs atypical timelines, the role of CSF analysis, and how to diagnose acute neuro‑BD even when MRI is unrevealing.

blogs.title: Hyponatraemia in Inflammatory Meningoencephalitis: SIADH as a Red Flag in Neuro‑Behçet’s
blogs.description: Explores the pathophysiology linking CNS inflammation to SIADH, with a focus on cytokine‑mediated ADH release (especially IL‑6). The post will outline a step‑by‑step approach to diagnosing SIADH in the setting of fever, headache, and hyponatraemia, and will highlight under‑appreciated signs such as hiccups and rhabdomyolysis.

blogs.title: Colchicine as First‑Line Therapy for Acute Neuro‑Behçet’s? Evidence, Mechanisms, and Practical Tips
blogs.description: Reviews the conventional use of high‑dose corticosteroids for neuro‑BD, then examines emerging data (including this case) suggesting colchicine monotherapy may suffice in selected patients. We’ll cover colchicine’s anti‑inflammatory actions, dosing strategies, monitoring, and when to consider escalation to immunosuppressants.

blogs.title: Diagnostic Overreach: How to Trim the Work‑up in Suspected Neuro‑Behçet’s Without Missing the Diagnosis
blogs.description: Analyzes the extensive infectious, neoplastic, and autoimmune panels often ordered in such cases. Provides an algorithm for a focused, hypothesis‑driven work‑up, emphasizing when tests like ACE, sIL‑2R, or broad viral panels add value versus when they merely increase cost and complexity.

blogs.title: Beyond the Ulcers: Systemic Behçet’s Disease and Endocrine Complications
blogs.description: Broadens the discussion to the spectrum of endocrine manifestations in Behçet’s, from SIADH to adrenal insufficiency and thyroiditis. The article will summarize reported cases, possible mechanisms, and recommendations for routine endocrine screening in newly diagnosed BD patients.

blogs.title: Managing Severe Hyponatraemia Safely in Neuro‑Inflammatory Disorders
blogs.description: A practical guide to fluid restriction, monitoring, and avoidance of rapid sodium correction in patients with SIADH secondary to CNS inflammation. Includes case‑based tips on when to use hypertonic saline, vasopressin antagonists, and how to coordinate care with neurology and nephrology.
